verdict.rationale: OpenCode is documented as an open-source agent you install and run on your own machine via curl or npm, with source on GitHub. `opencode serve` runs a headless HTTP server that TUI and web clients can attach to remotely, and it supports local models. Community users confirm running `opencode serve` and accessing it from anywhere, and using it with locally hosted models. Missing for 10: an explicit license statement and a deployment guide (e.g. containers or auth hardening); a community report says telemetry still goes to OpenCode's servers with no opt-out, and another says the server runs without authentication by default.
